description: This Java class 'TestlinkAPIXMLRPCClient' provides a client for reporting test execution results to the TestLink API via XML-RPC. It includes a method for sending test case results and a main method demonstrating its usage.

classes.name: TestlinkAPIXMLRPCClient
classes.description: A client class to communicate with TestLink's XML-RPC API for reporting test results.

methods.name: testLinkReport
methods.description: Sends a test case result to TestLink via XML-RPC with provided test case ID, plan ID, and status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Example entry point demonstrating how to call the testLinkReport method.
